investment-philosophy.title: Investment Philosophy
investment-philosophy.headline: Investment philosophy.
investment-philosophy.intro: Norvelian considers real estate through the relationship between the price of an asset, the durability of its cash flows and the risks of holding it over time.

topics.title: Asset fundamentals
topics.body: Location, accessibility, physical condition, tenant demand and competing supply inform the underlying investment thesis.

topics.title: Capital and risk
topics.body: Underwriting considers financing costs, vacancy, capital expenditure and the sensitivity of returns to changes in assumptions.

topics.title: Ownership horizon
topics.body: Acquisition, ongoing stewardship and potential exit decisions are considered together, rather than as isolated events.

investment-strategies.title: Investment Strategies
investment-strategies.headline: Investment strategies by property sector.
investment-strategies.intro: The source of occupier demand, income profile, development requirements and capital needs varies by property sector. Explore the factors relevant to each investment strategy.

topics.title: Market selection
topics.body: Local supply, demand and market structure inform the assessment of each opportunity.

topics.title: Investment structure
topics.body: The economics of the asset must be considered alongside financing, ownership arrangements and the intended holding period.

topics.title: Portfolio context
topics.body: Concentration, cash-flow resilience and the relationship with other exposures shape the investment assessment.

asset-management.title: Asset Management
asset-management.headline: Managing real estate assets.
asset-management.intro: Asset management connects the investment thesis with the day-to-day and long-term decisions that influence property performance.

topics.title: Operating performance
topics.body: Review rental income, operating costs, occupancy and performance against the assumptions of the business plan.

topics.title: Leasing and occupiers
topics.body: Consider tenant retention, lease maturity, market rents, incentives and the suitability of the property for occupier needs.

topics.title: Capital works
topics.body: Assess maintenance, redevelopment and capital expenditure in the context of asset condition, cost and longer-term value.

topics.title: Portfolio review
topics.body: Consider asset-level decisions alongside portfolio exposures, financing obligations and ownership objectives.

investment-strategies/commercial.title: Commercial Real Estate
investment-strategies/commercial.headline: The economics of commercial property.
investment-strategies/commercial.intro: Commercial property investment depends on the relationship between occupier demand, location, rental income and the cost of maintaining a competitive asset.

topics.title: Location and market
topics.body: Evaluate accessibility, competing stock, business activity and the prospects for occupier demand.

topics.title: Income and leases
topics.body: Consider tenant quality, lease duration, rent reviews, vacancy and costs associated with releasing space.

topics.title: Asset condition
topics.body: Assess capital requirements, operating efficiency and the adaptability of the property to changing needs.

investment-strategies/office.title: Office Assets
investment-strategies/office.headline: Space, occupiers and income.
investment-strategies/office.intro: Office investment requires an understanding of how businesses use space and how the quality and location of a building influence leasing demand.

topics.title: Occupier market
topics.body: Assess accessibility, amenities, competing office supply and tenant requirements.

topics.title: Leasing profile
topics.body: Review lease expiries, rent incentives, tenant concentration and renewal prospects.

topics.title: Building performance
topics.body: Consider building systems, maintenance and capital works required to sustain relevance.

investment-strategies/retail.title: Retail Properties
investment-strategies/retail.headline: Understanding the retail catchment.
investment-strategies/retail.intro: Retail property is shaped by consumer demand, connectivity, tenant mix and the ability of a location to attract recurring visits.

topics.title: Catchment
topics.body: Examine surrounding households, access, spending patterns and competing retail destinations.

topics.title: Tenancy
topics.body: Consider the commercial characteristics of tenants, lease structures and vacancy exposure.

topics.title: Adaptability
topics.body: Evaluate layout, operational requirements and potential capital works as retail patterns change.

investment-strategies/industrial-logisti.title: Industrial & Logistics
investment-strategies/industrial-logisti.headline: Location in the movement of goods.
investment-strategies/industrial-logisti.intro: Industrial and logistics assets connect land, transport infrastructure and occupier operations. Their suitability depends on more than the building alone.

topics.title: Connectivity
topics.body: Consider road access, distribution networks, labour availability and proximity to markets.

topics.title: Physical suitability
topics.body: Assess loading, clearances, circulation, utilities and the requirements of potential occupiers.

topics.title: Income and expenditure
topics.body: Evaluate lease commitments, maintenance needs and the investment required to support operational use.

investment-strategies/residential.title: Residential Investment Assets
investment-strategies/residential.headline: Housing demand and long-term value.
investment-strategies/residential.intro: Residential investment requires an understanding of household demand, affordability, location and the operating characteristics of housing assets.

topics.title: Demand
topics.body: Consider household formation, employment access, local supply and attainable rents.

topics.title: Property economics
topics.body: Assess acquisition cost, operating expenditure, vacancy and capital requirements.

topics.title: Portfolio perspective
topics.body: Consider geographic concentration, liquidity and the sensitivity of income to changing market conditions.

investment-strategies/strategic-land.title: Land & Strategic Property Investments
investment-strategies/strategic-land.headline: Land in its development context.
investment-strategies/strategic-land.intro: Land investment depends on ownership rights, planning constraints, infrastructure availability and the commercial feasibility of future uses.

topics.title: Site and context
topics.body: Assess access, location, surrounding development, services and physical constraints.

topics.title: Feasibility
topics.body: Consider permissible uses, development assumptions, costs and potential timing of approvals.

topics.title: Capital exposure
topics.body: Evaluate holding costs, uncertainty, exit alternatives and the sensitivity of value to development scenarios.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.headline: Real estate portfolio.
portfolio.intro: Norvelian’s investment focus encompasses several property sectors. The investment strategies section explains the factors considered when evaluating these assets.
